identity.title: [v0.92.1][CORP-03] Resolve provenance licensing and trademark dispositions

values.task_boundary: Implement only CORP-03 within its exact owned paths and authority boundary.
deliverables: Provenance and licensing matrix tied to the frozen asset denominator.
Trademark, domain, model, media, and third-party disposition register with owner and remediation route.
acceptance_criteria: Every critical source, model, dataset, media, and brand asset has a provenance and use-rights disposition.
Dependency and license conclusions cite machine-readable manifests or authoritative source evidence.
Unresolved or restricted assets are excluded from transfer and release gates rather than silently accepted.
Trademark conclusions are explicitly bounded and routed to counsel where legal judgment is required.
